pages.title: Profile Form: SwiftUI Profile Form Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: An edit-profile section: photo, name, a username that checks itself as it's typed, bio with a count, and Save.

pages.title: Step Form: SwiftUI Step Form Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A multi-step form container: a step indicator, your view per step, Back and Continue, Review with Edit, and Submit.

pages.title: Activity Timeline: SwiftUI Activity Timeline Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A day-by-day log on a rail: status-tinted nodes, attachment chips, folded runs, a filter by kind and paging to earlier activity.

pages.title: File List: SwiftUI File List Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A files section: storage by type, sort and list or grid, uploads with progress, rename, share, move and delete, and Add.

pages.title: Notification Inbox: SwiftUI Notification Inbox Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: An in-app notifications list: All, Mentions and Unread, day groups, inline Accept and Reply, swipe actions and Mark all as read.

pages.title: Search Panel: SwiftUI Search Panel Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The body of a search screen: recent and suggested searches, live suggestions with the match highlighted, and results by scope.

pages.title: Greeting Header: SwiftUI Greeting Header Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The top of a home tab: the date, a bell with its unread count, the avatar, a greeting by time of day and search, folding into a compact bar.

pages.title: Location Header: SwiftUI Location Header Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The header of a delivery or local app: the address and its chooser, search, a Now or Schedule pill, and the bag with its count.

pages.title: Scope Header: SwiftUI Scope Header Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A feed header: the title, scopes as text tabs with a sliding underline, filter chips that scroll, and a Filters button with its count.

pages.title: Selection Toolbar: SwiftUI Selection Toolbar Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: Edit mode for any list: a top bar with the count, Select all and Done, an action bar, selection circles on rows, and Undo.

pages.title: Attachment Composer: SwiftUI Attachment Composer Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A message composer that attaches photos and files, uploads each with its own progress ring, and turns Send into Stop.

pages.title: Dictation Composer: SwiftUI Dictation Composer Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A message composer with voice input: a live level meter, elapsed time, Cancel and Done, and the transcript filling the field.

pages.title: Command Composer: SwiftUI Command Composer Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A message composer with slash commands and at mentions: a filtered suggestion panel, chips for picks, and structured tokens on send.

pages.title: Model Composer: SwiftUI Model Composer Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A message composer with a model menu, Search, Think and Image chips, and a usage line that warns near the limit.

pages.title: Account Settings: SwiftUI Account Settings Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The account section at the top of Settings: profile and photo, appearance, notifications, your data, sign out and deletion.

pages.title: Help and Support: SwiftUI Help and Support Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The Help section of Settings: search that filters answers as you type, questions that open in place, chat, email, call and a problem report.

pages.title: Invite Friends: SwiftUI Invite Friends Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A referral section: what both people get, a track that fills as friends join, the invite code to copy or share, and who you invited.

pages.title: Notification Settings: SwiftUI Notification Settings Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The Notifications page of Settings: the real iOS permission, Push, Email and SMS per category, quiet hours and a digest that autosave.

pages.title: Plan and Usage: SwiftUI Plan and Usage Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The subscription section of Settings: the plan and its renewal, usage meters that warn near a limit, and the way up.

pages.title: Privacy Settings: SwiftUI Privacy Settings Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The Privacy page of Settings: each permission's real status with a tap to ask or change it, data toggles, a data export and the policies.

pages.title: Storage: SwiftUI Storage Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: The Storage page of Settings: what the app takes in a split bar, Clear cache that confirms and counts down, removable downloads and options.

pages.title: Permission Primer: SwiftUI Permission Primer Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: Explain-then-ask for notifications, location, the camera or photos, then answer what iOS says: granted, or Open Settings.

pages.title: Schedule Sheet: SwiftUI Schedule Sheet Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: Pick when something happens: quick picks with real times, a calendar and time picker, repeat rules and Schedule.

pages.title: Share Sheet: SwiftUI Share Sheet Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: Your app's own share sheet: the item up top, recent people to send to, Copy link, Save, Collection, More and Report.

pages.title: What's New: SwiftUI What's New Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A release notes sheet shown once per version: version and date, a title, features with symbols, Try it and Continue.

pages.title: Accessory Tab Bar: SwiftUI Accessory Tab Bar Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A tab bar with a live accessory above it for what is playing or running, folding inline into the bar as the content scrolls.

pages.title: Action Tab Bar: SwiftUI Action Tab Bar Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A floating tab bar with a round create button set apart that opens quick actions over a scrim, with badges and tap again to scroll up.

pages.title: Search Tab Bar: SwiftUI Search Tab Bar Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A floating tab bar with search set apart: tap it and the tabs fold away as it opens into a field over your recent searches.

pages.title: Top Tabs: SwiftUI Top Tabs Pattern (Pro) — SwiftPieces
pages.description: A scrolling strip of top tabs over swipeable pages, its indicator tracking the swipe and the strip keeping the selected tab in view.
